'''2007 Pennsylvania State Championship Vinay Bhasker LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Vinay Bhasker]] at [[2007 Pennsylvania State Championship]].

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
